dimensions.label: Delivered DiaSources per DiaObject
dimensions.definition: Count of delivered DiaSource rows grouped by diaObjectId within the cohort.
qualifications: Light Static carries no complete history; this is not a lifetime detection count.

dimensions.label: Delivered time baseline
dimensions.definition: last − first midpointMjdTai of delivered DiaSources (TAI day difference).
qualifications: Bounded by the cohort window; not the object's full baseline.
Zero for single-source DiaObjects.

dimensions.label: Peak DiaSource S/N
qualifications: Null when no delivered DiaSource has a positive snr.

dimensions.label: Peak difference-flux magnitude
qualifications: Difference-image flux, not a total magnitude; undefined without a positive psfFlux.

dimensions.label: g − r (mean difference-flux mag)
dimensions.definition: Mean positive-psfFlux AB magnitude in g minus that in r over delivered DiaSources.
qualifications: Non-contemporaneous bands.
Difference-image fluxes; not a source colour.
Requires positive flux in both bands.

dimensions.label: Reduced χ² about weighted mean (r)
dimensions.definition: lc_features["r"].chi2 from the latest delivered source-time snapshot in this basis. Fink computes lc_features over the history it holds for the object at alert time, which can include detections that were not delivered in this basis.
qualifications: Null where Fink delivered no r-band features or a non-finite value, or a non-positive value on this log axis.
dimensions.snapshot: Latest delivered snapshot; features summarize the history visible to Fink at that alert time, not a timeless object property.

dimensions.label: SuperNNova SN-vs-others score
dimensions.definition: clf.snnSnVsOthers_score from the latest delivered source-time snapshot in this basis.
qualifications: Model score, not a calibrated probability.
Values outside [0, 1] (Fink's −1 'not computed' sentinel) are shown as null here and kept verbatim in the inspector.
Population census over 6,311,364 DIA rows: 6,311,364 in [0, 1], 0 at −1, 0 null, 0 other.
dimensions.snapshot: Latest delivered snapshot; classifier outputs change as alerts arrive and are not timeless classifications.

dimensions.label: CATS score
dimensions.definition: clf.cats_score from the latest delivered source-time snapshot in this basis.
qualifications: Model score, not a calibrated probability.
Values outside [0, 1] (Fink's −1 'not computed' sentinel) are shown as null here and kept verbatim in the inspector.
Population census over 6,311,364 DIA rows: 6,308,395 in [0, 1], 0 at −1, 0 null, 2,969 other.
Where cats_class is −1 (no CATS class) the delivered cats_score 0.0 is a placeholder and is shown as null (3,557 of 5,000 sampled latest snapshots; inferred from the paired values).

dimensions.label: Galactic latitude b
dimensions.definition: Galactic latitude of the native entity position (ICRS -> Galactic, Astropy/Hipparcos rotation).

dimensions.label: Ecliptic latitude β
dimensions.definition: Mean ecliptic latitude of J2000.0 of the native entity position (ICRS frame bias ignored).
